problem_statement: Lab results from the request queue are no longer reaching the patient portal: since portal_client moved to the v2 releases endpoint, labportal/release_handlers.py still calls the removed v1 methods push_result / push_amendment and every release fails with AttributeError. Please migrate the release handler to PortalClient.release(ReleaseRequest(...)), following the example in reference/release_handlers_v2.py. Final and amended results both go through the single release() call now, and release.completed should carry the release_id from the receipt. The clinician-review hold must keep working. tests/test_release_handlers.py describes the expected behaviour.

Since `portal_client` switched to the v2 releases endpoint, lab results coming off the request queue have stopped showing up in the patient portal. The reason is that `labportal/release_handlers.py` is still invoking the v1 methods `push_result` / `push_amendment`, which have been removed, so every release blows up with `AttributeError`. Please port the release handler over to `PortalClient.release(ReleaseRequest(...))`, using `reference/release_handlers_v2.py` as the example to follow. Both final and amended results are now sent through the one `release()` call, and `release.completed` needs to carry the `release_id` taken from the receipt. The clinician-review hold has to keep working. Expected behaviour is described in `tests/test_release_handlers.py`.

This started when `portal_client` moved to the v2 releases endpoint: `labportal/release_handlers.py` is still calling `push_result` / `push_amendment`, the v1 methods that were removed. Could you migrate the release handler to `PortalClient.release(ReleaseRequest(...))`? Follow the example in `reference/release_handlers_v2.py`. Note that final and amended results now both go through the single `release()` call, and that `release.completed` should carry the receipt's `release_id`. The clinician-review hold still needs to work. `tests/test_release_handlers.py` describes the expected behaviour.
